models.observations: The upper keep, alternating conical and open wall towers and low gate court read clearly in all three LODs. Blue gate hangings, roof pennant and lit keep windows give the two warm roof colors a civic identity. Serialized LOD triangles 1648/983/421. The package check found no exposed coplanar faces.

A directional dish stands on a glazed command post above the detached guard booth. Bollards, a barrier arm and blue signals preserve the front approach. The silver-to-gold cladding reads in both age images. Serialized LOD triangles 847/479/256. The package check found no exposed coplanar faces.

A command annex with a large receiver, checkpoint and separate gatehouse reads at 64 px. The compact dark roof and lighter Modern wall define its main mass. The gray barrier and blue security drum bracket the entry. Serialized LOD triangles 723/451/204. The package check found no exposed coplanar faces.

Saw cut tips, a framed opening and the single blue standard identify a timber guard barrier. At phone size both Bronze and Iron resolve as virtually the same dark brown wall; their foreground channel difference averaged only 3.7 on a 255-point scale. Serialized LOD triangles 691/403/186. The package check found no exposed coplanar faces.
defects: Change the broad material selection of the pickets or crosshead to make the Bronze and Iron versions visibly distinct at 64 px while retaining credible timber construction.

models.observations: The taller hipped entry roof, bound wooden poles and hanging royal-blue badge read clearly. Roof and timber take a distinct darker Medieval row. The LOD2 block retains the sawtooth top and actual gateway. Serialized LOD triangles 693/421/160. The package check found no exposed coplanar faces.

The crenellated wall has battered supports, raised stone patches, and a blue heraldic hanging beside its arched postern. The warm Renaissance surface and darker Medieval plinth are distinct. Distant merlons and gate preserve the profile. Serialized LOD triangles 361/192/115. The package check found no exposed coplanar faces.

The parapet has become a metal coping on brick, with an amber sentinel light and Human pennant at the gate. A projecting doorway and pier buttresses survive at distance. Serialized LOD triangles 299/157/92. The package check found no exposed coplanar faces.

A timber trestle, visible ladder and upper gallery give this tower a strong vertical read. The four LOD2 roof posts start slightly above the reduced gallery wall after its rail disappears. Serialized LOD triangles 533/313/160. The package check found no exposed coplanar faces.
defects: Seat each LOD2 gallery pillar on the guard wall. The current post starts at guard + 0.012 while the wall terminates at guard; LOD2 omits the intermediate rail. Verify continuous bearing of the roof assembly.
